parse_notes: Three nonempty .log.json files were invalid as one-document JSON but parsed as JSONL: D_0913_retry=1011 objects (1000 train, 10 validation, 1 environment/header); trial_a=409 (400 train, 8 validation, 1 environment/header); trial_b=409 (400 train, 8 validation, 1 environment/header).
One unique invalid standard-JSON SHA is the empty byte string, repeated by 22 physical placeholder files. No values or run outcomes can be inferred from these files.
Metric node row count covers ordinary JSON parsing only; recovered JSONL records are indexed separately.

raw_jsonl.note: all physical valid lines previously parsed; duplicates grouped by SHA in runs_file_hash_inventory.json

limits: No model checkpoints executed or deserialized. No raw image/mask pixels were read.
JSON and CSV files were parsed structurally after exact-content deduplication; JSONL physical copies were parsed by prior inventory scan and are SHA-indexed.
Logs were fully scanned line by line after exact-content deduplication, with structured metric/lifecycle extraction; no assertion that every narrative line was manually interpreted.
YAML used safe_load only. Python config candidates used AST parsing only, never import/execution.
Some empty/truncated JSON records are listed as parse failures and must not be treated as absent runs or inferred outcomes.
JSON files with .log.json suffix are salvaged as JSONL where possible; the empty SHA group remains genuinely empty.

Training curves and per-class counts are machine-parsed throughout; human interpretation is curated for the key W48 runs, final product comparison, and failure probes. Logs were not manually paraphrased line by line.

Delegation text review is path/hash tracked; 59 complete documents were fully read by the two assigned reviewers. The remaining response file was read through its physical EOF but is itself truncated mid-expression, so missing continuation cannot be reconstructed.

archive_scope.source_archives: Covered by source_research_luna for source-member review; source artifacts are not evidence that an implementation ran.
notes: The 35 archive inventory includes large dataset/asset bundles, source patches, code snapshots, reports, and a small H0 metadata tar. Listing/hash inventory was performed; complete member interpretation is limited to the assigned machine/text material.
The H0 metadata tar was streamed only for text members (train.log, evaluation JSON/CSV, stop code), not weights.
No unsafe pickle/model checkpoint was loaded or executed.
No raw DDR/IDRiD image or mask pixel content was read.

practical_remaining: All 30 delegation texts assigned to this reviewer were read in full. implementation_model_response.txt is source/design evidence, not proof of execution; repair_tests_prompt.txt is a test-patch request with embedded test/source text, not proof tests ran.
One sibling-owned response file is physically truncated mid-Python expression and cannot be reconstructed; its bytes/hash were inventoried and its readable text was reviewed.
Large dataset/asset archives were not unpacked for image pixels; no run-result/config/log coverage remains outside the structured inventories, subject to source/archive-member limits above.
No new test inference/evaluation was performed; historical test measurements are cited only as recorded artifacts/reports.
